regime_context: The regime is a sequenced, interest-aligned campaign for structurally lower real yields plus strategic re-industrialization: the Fed (Warsh) holds a hawkish, inflation-first line while Treasury (Bessent) suppresses the front end via bill-heavy issuance, and industrial policy steers capital to defense, nuclear, power, and domestic chips. The consensus still reads the Fed as dovish because the market prices near-term cuts; revealed preference — hawkish guidance, dot-plot suspension, and a hike-majority tape after the Iran escalation — says the administration wants lower yields as an outcome, but only after it has banked inflation credibility, so near-term easing is gated, not granted.
regime_context_zh: 当前体制是一场有序推进、利益对齐的战略行动，目标是结构性压低实际利率并推动再工业化：美联储（Warsh）维持鹰派、通胀优先的立场，而财政部（Bessent）通过偏重短债发行来压低前端利率，产业政策则引导资本流向国防、核能、电力和本土芯片。市场共识仍把美联储读作鸽派，因为市场在定价近期降息；但所揭示的偏好——鹰派指引、暂停点阵图、以及伊朗局势升级后市场对加息概率过半的定价——说明政府想要的是低利率这个结果，只是要先积累通胀信誉，因此近期宽松是有条件的，而非理所当然。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and re-escalation realized the upside oil shock the substrate flagged; with Brent spiking and energy having been the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026, the realpolitik interest is to maintain an oil bid that reinforces the strong-dollar-while-easing bridge and pressures inflation optics without near-term Fed cuts. XLE is the cleanest scorable proxy for the oil leg of that stagflationary split.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂和局势再升级兑现了情报中提示的油价上行冲击；在布伦特油价飙升、且能源板块是2026年一季度ETF资金流入最多的行业背景下，现实利益在于维持油价支撑，既强化“强势美元+宽松”的汇率桥梁，又在不进行近期降息的情况下制造通胀压力。XLE是这一滞胀分化中油价端最清晰的、可评分的代理标的。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict
Rotation theme: Energy (oil & gas) with proxies XLE, XOP
theses.dissent: A genuine de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalization would unwind the risk premium fast, and XLE's recent hit rate vs SPY is fragile given the track record.
theses.dissent_zh: 一旦真正降温或霍尔木兹海峡航运恢复正常，风险溢价会迅速消退；而且从过往战绩看，XLE相对SPY的胜率并不稳固。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more before the 42-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在42天核查日之前，XLE落后SPY达到5%或更多

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: The NATO structural spending super-cycle plus the Iran re-escalation re-primes the defense bid; the substrate labels defense as targeted/high-confidence, and ITA is the primary scorable proxy for defense primes and missile-defense exposure that benefits regardless of ceasefire outcomes.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约结构性军费超级周期叠加伊朗局势再升级，重新点燃了国防板块的买盘；情报将国防标记为目标明确、置信度较高的主题，ITA是国防主承包商和导弹防御敞口最核心的可评分代理标的，无论停火结果如何都能受益。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle, FACT basis
Rotation theme: Defense · shipbuilding · missile defense with proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD
Iran theater: Defense bid persists regardless of ceasefire status
theses.dissent: Prior ITA overweight calls missed recently; defense equities have already priced a long-running super-cycle, and a genuine peace negotiation could compress valuations even with sustained budgets.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前ITA的增持判断最近曾经失手；国防股已经计价了长期超级周期，一旦真正的和谈出现，即使预算维持，估值也可能被压缩。

falsifier.text: ITA underperforms SPY by 6% or more before the 63-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在63天核查日之前，ITA跑输SPY达到6%或更多

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With CME FedWatch above 70% for a September hike and Warsh holding a hawkish inflation-first line, long-duration Treasuries face near-term repricing risk; the administration's yield suppression is aimed at the front end, not the long end, so TLT is exposed to the hawkish staging phase while BIL/SHV capture the intended policy effect.
theses.thesis_zh: CME FedWatch显示9月加息概率超过70%，而Warsh坚持鹰派、通胀优先的立场，长久期美债面临近期重新定价的风险；政府的收益率抑制针对的是前端而非长端，因此TLT暴露在鹰派铺垫阶段的风险中，而BIL/SHV才是政策意图的受益端。
evidence: Open prediction: The Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings (hold or hike)
Market state: fed_path_gap shows market more dovish than Fed, 15bp
Thesis: hawkish tape staging phase, Sept hike >70% probability after Iran escalation
theses.dissent: A labor-market crack beyond the June payrolls weak print could force a data-driven September pivot, sending long-end yields down sharply and TLT up vs SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 若劳动力市场在6月疲弱就业数据基础上进一步恶化，可能迫使美联储在9月转向数据驱动的宽松，导致长端收益率大幅下行、TLT跑赢SPY。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% or more before the 30-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在30天核查日之前，TLT跑赢SPY达到5%或更多

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a real industrial-policy lever, but the track record shows recent OKLO overweights missed hard (-0.53 and -0.62 realized), and the falsifiable catalysts in the substrate — HALEU releases, contracted reactor projects — have not yet been confirmed as realized policy. The honest lean is to avoid re-adding exposure until a concrete DOE or project milestone lands.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能服务AI是真实的产业政策杠杆，但过往战绩显示近期的OKLO增持判断大幅失手（-0.53和-0.62），而情报中可证伪的催化剂——HALEU投放、已签约的反应堆项目——尚未确认落地。诚实的倾向是在DOE或项目里程碑真正兑现之前避免重新加仓。
evidence: Track record: OKLO overweight miss -0.5348 (check 2026-11-04) and -0.6168 (check 2026-11-05)
Open predictions: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into fuel bank; AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows contracted/sited project — both unconfirmed
Rotation theme: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU with proxies including OKLO
theses.dissent: A single DOE HALEU release or a named reactor contract could re-rate the entire nuclear complex violently and leave an avoid call behind within days.
theses.dissent_zh: 只要DOE宣布一次HALEU投放或一个具名反应堆合同，整个核能板块可能剧烈重估，几天内就能让回避判断明显落后。

falsifier.text: OKLO outperforms SPY by 20% or more before the 30-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在30天核查日之前，OKLO跑赢SPY达到20%或更多
